item.title: Community Cinema Course Returns to Penn State Schuylkill This Spring
item.description: Penn State Schuylkill will once again host its popular community enrichment cinema course this spring, inviting participants to take a deeper look at how comedy has evolved in film and what those changes say about modern culture and public discourse. The four-part course, titled Media, Manipulation, and the Demise of Public Discourse, will explore humor’s shifting role in cinema, including the decline of the traditional romantic comedy.
